name: component-stage-unknown
summary: A registry component's stage is alpha, beta or ga.
explanation: The maturity ladder has exactly three rungs, and the compiler enforces what each one allows. A stage outside the ladder has no defined meaning, so no rule about golden paths, opt-in or sunsets can apply to it. A declared field cannot hold an enumeration, so this check carries the vocabulary. Set the stage to alpha, beta or ga.
query:
SELECT id AS record,
       'Registry component ' || id || ' has stage ' || stage || ', which is not alpha, beta or ga.' AS message
FROM registry_component
WHERE stage NOT IN ('alpha', 'beta', 'ga')
ORDER BY record

name: component-sunset-wrong
summary: An alpha or beta component carries a sunset date, and a ga component carries none.
explanation: A stage without a clock becomes permanent, which is how an experimental tier turns into a dumping ground. An alpha or beta component therefore states the date it stops working, and a ga component states none, because a ga component does not expire. Add the sunset date, or clear it if the component is ga.
query:
SELECT id AS record,
       CASE WHEN stage IN ('alpha', 'beta')
            THEN 'Registry component ' || id || ' is ' || stage || ', so it must carry a sunset date.'
            ELSE 'Registry component ' || id || ' is ga, so it must not carry a sunset date.' END AS message
FROM registry_component
WHERE (stage IN ('alpha', 'beta') AND sunset IS NULL)
   OR (stage = 'ga' AND sunset IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY record

name: library-contract-not-normative
summary: A library contract states no obligation.
explanation: A library contract is a promise a runtime package makes to every service that imports it, and a service owner relies on it without reading the code; a statement with no MUST, MUST NOT, SHOULD, SHOULD NOT or MAY promises nothing. State the promise with one of those words.
query: SELECT id AS record, 'Library contract ' || id || ' states no obligation: its statement names none of MUST, MUST NOT, SHOULD, SHOULD NOT or MAY.' AS message FROM library_contract WHERE statement NOT LIKE '%MUST%' AND statement NOT LIKE '%SHOULD%' AND statement NOT LIKE '%MAY%' ORDER BY record

name: manual-test-in-spec
summary: A test of STEGO's own spec is manual.
explanation: Decided on 2026-10-31 (ST-ASR-Q01): STEGO's evidence is a proof run attested at an exact commit, and a manual test has no runner output, so nothing can attest it and the release gate cannot tell a manual test that was run from one that was not. STEGO's own spec therefore holds no manual test: every test is automated, or not automated yet until it is. Automate the test, or set its state to not automated yet with no manual reason.
query: SELECT t.id AS record, 'Test ' || t.id || ' is manual; STEGO''s own spec holds no manual test (ST-ASR-Q01): automate it, or mark it not automated yet.' AS message FROM (SELECT id, state FROM constraint_test UNION ALL SELECT id, state FROM domain_service_test UNION ALL SELECT id, state FROM invariant_test UNION ALL SELECT id, state FROM specification_test UNION ALL SELECT id, state FROM standard_rule_test UNION ALL SELECT id, state FROM use_case_test) t WHERE t.state = 'manual' ORDER BY record

name: output-contract-not-normative
summary: An output contract states MUST, MUST NOT, SHOULD, SHOULD NOT or MAY.
explanation: A contract that states no obligation cannot be satisfied or proved, and a description of behavior reads as one until someone tries to test it. Restate it with MUST, MUST NOT, SHOULD, SHOULD NOT or MAY, or remove it.
query:
SELECT id AS record,
       'Output contract ' || id || ' states no obligation: its statement names none of MUST, MUST NOT, SHOULD, SHOULD NOT or MAY.' AS message
FROM output_contract
WHERE statement NOT LIKE '%MUST%' AND statement NOT LIKE '%SHOULD%' AND statement NOT LIKE '%MAY%'
ORDER BY record

name: registry-part-not-listed
summary: A registry component or runtime package is not listed in the Registry aggregate.
explanation: Every component and runtime package is one part of the registry's catalog, and the Serves reach finds it only through its listed_in link to ST-SUP-A1: without the link the part, its output or library contracts and its generator serve no outcome and count for nothing. Link the part to ST-SUP-A1 with listed_in.
query: SELECT p.id AS record, p.label || ' ' || p.id || ' is not listed in the Registry aggregate: link it to ST-SUP-A1 with listed_in.' AS message FROM (SELECT id, 'Registry component' AS label FROM registry_component UNION ALL SELECT id, 'Runtime package' AS label FROM runtime_package) p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM listed_in l WHERE l.source_id = p.id AND l.target_id = 'ST-SUP-A1') ORDER BY record

name: unwritten-record-names-existing-file
summary: A technical record that says it is not written yet names a file that does not exist yet.
explanation: A record whose description starts Not written yet marks code that is planned. Once its file exists, Lathe counts what it implements as built, so a stale marker overstates nothing but a planned record whose file exists must be checked: the file may hold only part of what the record names. Data models, value types, predicates, event types, services and tables carry no description, so the check cannot watch them; their file alone says whether they are built. Write the code the record names, or point the record at a planned file that does not exist yet, then remove the marker.
query:
SELECT t.id AS record, 'Technical record ' || t.id || ' says it is not written yet, but names ' || f.file || ', which exists; what it implements counts as built.' AS message
FROM (SELECT id, 'cli_command' AS kind, description FROM "cli_command"
UNION ALL SELECT id, 'command_handler' AS kind, description FROM "command_handler"
UNION ALL SELECT id, 'query_handler' AS kind, description FROM "query_handler"
UNION ALL SELECT id, 'event_handler' AS kind, description FROM "event_handler"
UNION ALL SELECT id, 'endpoint_handler' AS kind, description FROM "endpoint_handler"
UNION ALL SELECT id, 'projection' AS kind, description FROM "projection"
UNION ALL SELECT id, 'repository' AS kind, description FROM "repository"
UNION ALL SELECT id, 'adapter' AS kind, description FROM "adapter"
UNION ALL SELECT id, 'ui_component' AS kind, description FROM "ui_component") t
JOIN file_facts f ON f.record = t.id AND f.file_exists
WHERE t.description LIKE 'Not written yet%'
ORDER BY record
